title: Prevented is Not Protected: What Attack Success Rate Hides about RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.40742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is vulnerable to knowledge poisoning, where adversaries manipulate retrieved evidence to influence model outputs. Existing defenses are primarily evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which obscures defense-induced failures and the mechanisms behind apparent attack prevention. To address this issue, this work introduces \textbf{Aligned RAG Evaluation}, a matched-query protocol that jointly examines clean and poisoned responses, with and without defense. By combining matched conditions analysis, LLM-judge endorsement, and retrieval dependence controls, the proposed framework distinguishes prevented from introduced failures, target mentions from LLM endorsement, and single-passage influence from evidence composition. Experiments on HotpotQA and Natural Questions reveal that existing defenses can introduce unexpected target-positive answers, although they can prevent some attacks, while evaluation

translated_title: 阻止并非保护：攻击成功率掩盖了RAG的哪些问题
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）容易受到知识投毒攻击，即攻击者通过操纵检索到的证据来影响模型输出。现有防御方法主要使用攻击成功率（ASR）进行评估，这一指标掩盖了防御本身引发的故障以及表面防御成功背后的机制。为了解决这一问题，本工作提出了“对齐RAG评估”，这是一种匹配查询协议，可联合检验干净与被投毒的响应，涵盖有防御与无防御两种情况。通过结合匹配条件分析、LLM判官认可以及检索依赖性控制，所提出的框架能够区分“被阻止的失败”与“被引入的失败”、目标提及与LLM认可、以及单段落影响与证据组合的影响。在HotpotQA和Natural Questions上的实验表明，现有防御方法虽然能够阻止部分攻击，却会引入意想不到的目标正向答案，而评估……
tldr: 该论文提出“对齐RAG评估”（ARE）框架，通过匹配查询协议揭示攻击成功率指标所掩盖的问题：现有RAG防御方法虽能阻止部分投毒攻击，却可能引入意外的目标正向回答。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Aligned RAG Evaluation (ARE), a matched-query protocol revealing what attack success rate (ASR) hides: existing RAG defenses can prevent some poisoning attacks yet introduce unexpected target-positive answers.
